answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply sorts its items into 'Fix before launch', then 'Fix next', then 'Smaller fixes', and its 'Suggested order' calls items 1 to 6 launch blockers. It also says what it could not check and leaves to a person: "I didn't drive the site in a real browser, phone or screen reader in this run, so check the top items on an actual phone before launch." It flags the mobile-number rule as something to check with the service owner.

mapping.title: Tapping 'Book this slot' twice cancels the booking, but the done page still says 'Booked'
mapping.reason: The button gives no feedback during the 1.5 s wait, and a second tap cancels the booking while the done page still says 'Booked'. This is the same harm as D09.

mapping.title: 'Today' is hard-coded as Monday 12 October 2026, so the quick-day buttons and the 14-day window are stale
mapping.reason: The fixed date is the fixture's simulated clock: the ground truth itself says today is Monday 12 October at 10:05. The review also guesses it is a demo setting. A resident in this flow is not hurt by it. (The passed-slot part of the same paragraph is R3.)

mapping.title: The slot list ignores the clock, so today's slots that have passed or are about to start show as free
mapping.reason: The review says today's slots that have already passed still show as free. Its fix (hide or disable same-day slots that start less than 30 minutes from now) would fix D06, which is today's started or about-to-start slots being offered and then refused.

mapping.title: The 5-minute slot hold is never shown, is only checked at Book, and gives a misleading 'no longer available' with no link back
mapping.reason: The five-minute hold runs out unseen and the slot is dropped at Book with 'This slot is no longer available'. This is D08 exactly.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots jump out of time order to the top of the grid, so the reading and focus order differs from what is on screen
mapping.reason: The order:-1 on 'Few left' slots moves them in front of the chronological slots and above the Morning heading. Keyboard and screen-reader order then differs from what is on screen. This is D10.

mapping.title: Slot buttons have no keyboard focus indicator
mapping.reason: A style injected at run time (.slot:focus{outline:0}) removes the focus ring on the slot buttons only. This is D05.

mapping.title: The slot grid runs off the screen on phones 360 px wide and below, and when zoomed
mapping.reason: The resize script sizes three columns from the window width, ignoring padding and gaps, so the grid overflows at 360 px and below and the page scrolls sideways. This is D04.

mapping.title: Van and trailer users only find out about the permit at the last step
mapping.reason: The review covers the rule hidden behind an 'i' icon, the permit field that appears 1.2 s late, no check on the vehicle page, and the error only after Book with no link back. All of these are D07.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tags fail colour contrast in both themes
mapping.reason: The review reports amber on amber at 3.0:1 in light mode and 3.4:1 in dark mode for 16 px bold text, below the 4.5:1 required. This is D03.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' loses the chosen day and doesn't say the rest of the booking is kept
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' returns to Today with no slot selected and doesn't say the details are kept. This is D12.

mapping.title: The confirmation (done) page shows only the reference, not the day, time or vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page lacks the day, the slot and the vehicle the resident needs at the gate. This is D14.

mapping.title: Slots blank for almost a second on every day change with no loading message, and Next silently does nothing
mapping.reason: This is the wait itself: nothing says slots are coming, and Next does nothing in the meantime. That is D01.

mapping.title: The slot-count live region is only switched on as the first result appears, so screen readers miss the first announcement
mapping.reason: aria-live is added only after the count is written, so the screen reader is not told the slots have arrived or how many there are. This is D11.

mapping.title: 'Today' is selected by default although most residents book the evening before
mapping.reason: Residents who book the evening before, as the brief says most do, land on a day with nothing left to book and must notice and switch. With today's passed slots still shown as free, the default also steers them toward a slot that will be refused. Picking the default day is a separate problem from D06 and is not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: The arrival rule and the slot's end time are only in a tooltip that phones never show
mapping.reason: The slot's end time and 'arrive within your slot' appear only in a title tooltip, so phone users never see them. This is D13.

mapping.title: The 'Another day' date field opens a numbers-only iPhone keypad with no '/' while the hint asks for DD/MM/YYYY
mapping.reason: A resident on an iPhone, the main device here, can't type the format the hint asks for. They may get stuck or give up choosing a date further ahead. Not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: The vehicle error isn't connected: the summary link targets an element that can't take focus, and the error isn't tied to the buttons
mapping.reason: A keyboard or screen-reader user who follows 'Choose the vehicle' from the error summary doesn't land on the vehicle choice. They also aren't told the error when they reach the buttons, which makes the vehicle step harder to recover from. Not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: The waste hint about bag and mattress limits isn't read out by screen readers
mapping.reason: The hint is attached through aria-describedby on a plain div, so screen-reader users miss the bag and mattress limits. They could then arrive with a load the gate refuses. Not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Registration field should have autocapitalize='characters'
mapping.reason: This is a polish suggestion. The review describes no harm, such as a rejected or mismatched registration, that it would prevent.

mapping.title: A UK mobile number is required, so residents without one can't book online
mapping.reason: The review reads the rule from the code: the field is required and accepts only UK mobiles. Residents with only a landline or a non-UK number are locked out of booking a council service online. Not in the ground truth.
